description: This file defines the SearchPreference interface and related functions for JSON serialization/deserialization, representing user search preferences in the application.

methods.name: instanceOfSearchPreference
methods.description: Checks if a given object implements the SearchPreference interface by verifying the presence of the 'user' property.

methods.name: SearchPreferenceFromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into a SearchPreference object.

methods.name: SearchPreferenceFromJSONTyped
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into a SearchPreference object with optional discriminator handling.

methods.name: SearchPreferenceToJSON
methods.description: Serializes a SearchPreference object into JSON format.
